messages:
anya: Heads-up  opened a docs PR to update PilotX9B model card. Changes: per-variant max seq, explicit embed-sharding guidance, split throughput benches by variant/quant, and a short migration note for teams moving to 64k windows. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5108 :rocket:

matt: thanks. quick question  why do the 64k numbers look ~30% lower than the public catalog? are we mixing runs from different GPUs or batch sizes? :thinking:

anya: good catch. previous table accidentally averaged int8 and fp16 runs and omitted the GPU column. fixed in draft: 64k runs = A100-80GB, pinned-seqlen, bs=1, fp16; 32k runs = A100-40GB, bs=2. splitting bench into separate rows now and adding raw bench script link.

ravi: request: include a short Go SDK snippet showing streaming generation on the 64k variant with graceful fallback to CPU for cold starts, plus an embeddings example that sets shard_hint to the new taxonomy. proposed snippets below, keep tiny:

```go
// streaming generation with cpu fallback
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, _ := client.Generate(redwood.GenerateParams{
  Model: "pilotx9b-pro-64k",
  Input: "Summarize the attached log file:",
  Stream: true,
  Fallback: redwood.Fallback{Mode: "cpu"},
})
for chunk := range resp.Stream() { fmt.Print(chunk.Text) }

// embeddings with shard hint
emb := client.Embeddings.Create(redwood.EmbeddingsParams{
  Model: "pilotx9b-pro",
  Input: "Customer email thread...",
  ShardHint: "nl:long",
})
fmt.Println(len(emb.Data[0].Embedding))
```

qa-maya: please add the eval checklist before merge: reproduce pinned 64k on A100-80GB, reproduce 32k on A100-40GB, run tokenization diff on 100 mixed prompts, verify embedding-shard idempotency for the shardable variants, and run mem-smoke loop with 200 open/close contexts. I'll queue runs once draft is ready (ETA ~5h).

matt: tiny docs nit  model card links to old runtime-compat page. replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/compatibility#kv-cache-behavior and add a note about pinned-seqlen effects on throughput.

docs-bot: lint: models/pilotx9b.md  headings OK, found 2 markdown-link warnings (lines 67, 141) and one long line warning (line 98).

anya: thanks  fixing links and shortening that long line. I'll also call out that the quantized variant has a lower effective seq ceiling (recommend customers use the fp16 variant for 64k windows) and add a short rationale in the "supported variants" section. Assigning reviewers @matt @ravi @qa-maya. Target to merge by COB Friday so it lands in the next catalog cut. :calendar:

ravi: I'll review the Go snippets and the shard taxonomy mapping tomorrow AM.

qa-maya: queued the evals; will post results in this thread once complete. If embedding idempotency fails we should block and open an infra ticket.

anya: noted. tagging product/support so they get the non-shardable/quant caveat in customer-facing summaries. :white_check_mark:
